name: Ground bounce: a down dash into the floor and a jump in it
techNote: A metal floor (top y 0). Jump, then 6 ticks later dash straight down with jump on dash frame 3: the landing ends the dash (DashBounceFrames 4) and the buffered jump is the ground bounce, Velocity.y 805 plus 600 momentum up (dashBounceMagnitude; 586.6 after the tick). It peaks at y 587.7 (hitbox top 614.5) and is in the finish box over the start (y 530-610) on tick 37; a jump peaks at 291.8 and a jump with an up dash at 437.7.
